pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions within 30 minutes of a prior entry or inside the same price consolidation band; second-tranche entries require a verified structural breakout and minimum +$10 floating profit on the primary trade.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume-weighted average spread and localized ATR filter must confirm directional momentum before order execution; no entries allowed during 1-minute candle ranges exceeding 2.5x the 20-period average ATR.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stops once a trade reaches +$8.00 and execute mandatory partial or full scale-out if momentum stalls below the +$15.00 to +$30.00 target zone.
